newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 26.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Chinese investors rush to buy new shares issued by large companies, indicating they now more likely to buy stocks for investment rather than speculation.
- Property sales in the Pudong New Area hit 1.23 billion yuan in the first four months of this year, four times that of the same period last year.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Over-production in refrigerators has become an increasingly serious problem with many small producers facing closure due to fierce competition.
